fields.why: Auto Operational requirements for Gravity Tails line flushing valves (233-XV-3115, 234-XV-3116 & 234-XV-3117) to be refined to assist with line blockage prevention.
fields.design:
Purpose:
This automatic valve flushing sequence serves as a last resort to prevent the gravity line from blocking when other methods have failed.

Add Open Permissive Interlocks:
- 361-PU-761 Raw Water Pump 1 Running OR
- 361-PU-762 Raw Water Pump 2 Running
This Permissive Interlocks is to reduce the risk of contaminating the raw water lines with slurry. It is highly recommended to install non-return valves upstream of these flushing valves to provide mechanical protection.

Gravity Tails Line Flushing Valves Auto Sequence: 233-SEQ-001
Trigger Conditions:
1. If DT-3031 is High High and FT-3030 is low low and no pump is running for 30 seconds. OR
2. After the 5-min Flushing Sequence as part of the PCSCR-685 is completed and FT-3030 still Low-Low.
A popup shall be displayed on SCADA to advise the Operator to start this flushing valves. If no decision is made within 30s of the popup, the sequence shall proceed automatically.

Steps:
1. Interlock both 233-PU-057 and 233-PU-557 from running. (Suction valve and Drain Valves will close and open as part of the current logic, Discharge Valve will remain open)
2. Open XV-3117 for 2 minutes.
3. Close XV-3117
4. Open XV-3116 for 2 minutes.
5. Close XV-3116
6. Open XV-3115 for 2 minutes.
7. Close XV-3115

Minor Updates to PCSCR-685:
1. DT-3031 High Alarm: Update setpoint to 1.35 (one of three conditions triggering plant feed interlock and flushing sequence popup)
2. DT-3031 High-High Alarm: Update setpoint to 1.50 (immediately triggers plant feed interlock and flushing sequence popup)
3. SCADA HMI: Add "All-to-Auto" button for PU-057, PU-557, and their associated valves
fields.impact: Line flushing becomes automatic (with CRO popup) when a blockage condition is detected.
